The '''P-s5.6 twin ion engine''' was a model of [[Twin ion engine/Legends|twin ion engine]] manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] incorporated paired P-s5.6 twin ion engines linked to an [[I-s3a solar ionization reactor/Legends|I-s3a solar ionization reactor]] to give the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] a more powerful drive system than the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]].<ref name="EGVV" /> The P-s5.6 model was also fitted aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]], making them among the fastest [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. These engines were rated at 175 [[KTU]].<ref name="SC">{{StoryCite|story=The Stele Chronicles|book=Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)}}</ref>
